svg.title: Injury triage: a conversation, operator by operator
svg.text: Injury triage: what happens in a conversation

g.text: classify the description into a tier,
shows the checklist and next step,
then waits for an update or command
does the text say it's done?

svg.text: typed at the Update prompt instead of an update
priority: when several operators apply, the lowest number runs first (P1 read · P2 confirm · P3 command · P4 interpret · P5 close · P6 advise)
LLM suggestions never reach the incident record directly: each one waits for a human yes or no.
